response.answer: Innovative trends in Business, Economics & Management focus on financial self-efficacy, budgeting adherence, and advanced causal analysis methods. Key trends include psychological mechanisms like mental budgeting and self-control enhancing financial literacy's impact on well-being. Advanced causal analysis methods are increasingly used to explore these relationships.
